sources.kind: retained actual version-only browser probe over private pipes before document input

decisions: Check exact engine product/revision/protocol before sending document data
Create a fresh host and off-the-record browser context per job; default source scripts off
Never fetch unknown resources implicitly; strict losses latch and permissive losses remain observable
Use native lifecycle plus isolated synchronous font inspection, including when source scripts are disabled
Stream bounded PDF chunks and import with the ordinary managed reader under the same context
limitations: Protocol/schema and small actual fixtures do not qualify complete HTML/script/font/print semantics
Qualified deployable OS host, every actual supported browser lane, complete asset/license/security/fuzz/endurance and final packages remain mandatory
